verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a Developer Sandbox that replicates core v2 API functionality using test funds and an automated system that simulates normal activity. Developers can mock flows and execute transfers there. They can fund the account with test USD and Paxos stablecoins through the Dashboard Fund button, or deposit testnet and faucet crypto to sandbox deposit addresses. Missing for 10: no documented deterministic test values (e.g., magic amounts that trigger specific outcomes), no explicit confirmation that payouts/fiat withdrawals and conversions are covered in sandbox beyond the general 'core v2 API' claim, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
